method: Measured from real runs on current main (10ee468) on the sandbox (1.5 shared CPUs). Paired wall times are the median of three smoke runs (A: 1401/709/905 ms; D: 13290/12396/9500 ms). Stress numbers are the first green run; a second run on the same machine measured growth 0.9x/3.3x/5.9x/11.7x, inside the 2x tolerance. RSS deltas are recorded for the record, not gated: the two runs measured 3368 vs 11708 KiB at level 32 on identical code (allocator retention noise), so a cross-run RSS comparison would fail on noise; the in-test per-level RSS bound is the RSS gate.
